description: Top-level domains added to or removed from IANA's root, newest first, with the IANA list version each happened in. Nobody else publishes this diff.

change.description: added, removed or returned (optional), e.g. added

limit.description: Rows to return, integer 1-1000, default 100, e.g. 25

since.description: ISO 8601 time: only changes after it (optional), e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z

name: tld_changes
